queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(li.product_price) AS mean_product_price,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_mean_product_price,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count
FROM invoice_averages

WITH eligible_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
    HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
)
SELECT
    AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_mean_product_price,
    AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count
FROM eligible_invoices

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(mean_price)
   FROM (
     SELECT AVG(product_price) AS mean_price
     FROM Invoice_Line_Items
     GROUP BY invoice_number
     HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
   )) AS average_mean_product_price,
  (SELECT AVG(line_item_count)
   FROM (
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
     FROM Invoice_Line_Items
     GROUP BY invoice_number
   )) AS average_line_item_count

SELECT
  AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price,
  AVG(priced_line_item_count) AS average_priced_line_item_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_product_price,
    COUNT(ili.product_price) AS priced_line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)

SELECT
    AVG(mean_product_price),
    AVG(priced_line_item_count)
FROM (
    SELECT
        AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price,
        COUNT(product_price) AS priced_line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
    HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
)

WITH invoice_stats AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(product_price) AS mean_product_price,
        COUNT(product_price) AS priced_line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
    AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_price,
    AVG(priced_line_item_count) AS average_priced_line_item_count
FROM invoice_stats
